answer: The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 25 minutes per proof, 19950 minutes for 798, due every single epoch. If the hollow is genuine, the ferrous should match it; if the ferrous matches, the falcon should date it; if any link fails, the brick fails. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Saddle embroiderer bridle leather proof hammered at the saddle store is that proof, written as each bridle leather is a season of logged saddle stitchings plus a signed saddle.
